flashcard_questions.q: Materials that occur naturally and can be used by humans, including water, wood, metals, and fossil fuels.
A resource that is being used up faster than it can be replaced, such as fossil fuels and metal ores.
A resource that can be replaced at the same rate it is used, such as wood from managed forests or crops.

flashcard_questions.a: An artificially produced chemical containing nitrogen, phosphorus, or potassium, added to soil to promote plant growth.
Meeting the needs of the current generation without compromising the ability of future generations to meet their own needs.
